lokasi: Uwais's small bedroom before dawn: a single bed with a grey blanket against the left wall, a small wooden nightstand beside the bed with one round silver twin-bell alarm clock, a wooden door on the right, a window showing a dark blue pre-dawn sky, a dim warm night lamp.

pakaian.UWAIS: loose plain navy-blue long-sleeved pajama top and matching navy pajama trousers, barefoot

serial.pesan: Subuh lebih berharga dari dunia dan isinya

youtube.title: Bangun Subuh Tanpa Alarm 5 Kali | Uwais Hijrah #2
youtube.description:
Alarm bunyi, tidur lagi... alarm bunyi lagi! Akhirnya Uwais bangun dan berdoa.

Doa bangun tidur: Alhamdulillahilladzi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin nusyur. (HR. Bukhari 6312)

Hari 2 dari 30.

#30HariUwaisHijrah #JOTA #shorts

shots.title: Alarm berdering
shots.adegan: Close shot of the small wooden nightstand in the dark bedroom before dawn: one round silver twin-bell alarm clock stands on it, lit by the dim warm night lamp; behind it, out of focus, the edge of the bed with the grey blanket. The room is empty of people in this shot.
alur: The alarm clock on the nightstand starts ringing and shakes slightly on the wooden top.
The camera slowly pushes in toward the ringing clock.
The clock keeps ringing and shaking in place.
shots.kamera: close shot on the alarm clock, slow push-in toward the clock
shots.akhir: The alarm clock is still ringing on the nightstand, in the center of the frame.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

foley.suara: a loud old twin-bell alarm clock ringing

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

shots.gerak: The alarm clock rings and shakes slightly on the nightstand while the camera slowly pushes in toward it.

shots.title: Masih jam 4
shots.adegan: Uwais sits up in the bed with the grey blanket over his legs, the alarm clock quiet on the nightstand beside him.
alur: Uwais reaches to the nightstand with his right hand and picks up the alarm clock.
He holds the clock with both hands at chest height in front of him, head upright.
He puts the clock back on the nightstand and rests his hands on the blanket.
shots.kamera: medium shot at eye level, static
shots.akhir: Uwais sits upright in bed with his hands resting on the blanket, the clock back on the nightstand.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed, then held in both hands at chest height
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

dialog.text: [sleepy] Aduuh... masih jam empat nih. Tidur lagi, ya.

shots.title: Tidur lagi
shots.adegan: Medium close shot of the nightstand and the alarm clock beside the bed, the dim warm night lamp glowing, the window behind showing a dark blue pre-dawn sky. No person is in this shot.
alur: The second hand of the alarm clock ticks steadily.
The warm lamp light flickers very softly on the wall.
The camera slowly drifts closer to the quiet clock.
shots.kamera: medium close shot on the nightstand, very slow push-in
shots.akhir: The quiet alarm clock fills the center of the frame on the nightstand.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

shots.gerak: The clock ticks quietly on the nightstand while the camera slowly drifts closer.

shots.title: Alarm lagi
shots.adegan: The round silver twin-bell alarm clock stands on the small wooden nightstand, and right beside it the edge of the bed with the grey blanket, lit by the dim warm night lamp.
alur: The alarm clock rings again and shakes slightly on the nightstand.
A hand in a navy pajama sleeve comes out from under the edge of the grey blanket and reaches the clock.
The hand presses the button on top of the clock and the ringing stops; the hand rests beside the clock.
shots.kamera: close shot at nightstand height, static
shots.akhir: The quiet clock stands on the nightstand, the hand resting beside it on the wooden top.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

foley.suara: a loud old twin-bell alarm clock ringing
a click as an alarm clock button is pressed and the ringing stops

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

shots.gerak: The clock rings, a hand in a navy pajama sleeve reaches out from the blanket and presses the button, and the ringing stops.
shots.shot: Close shot at nightstand height, static.

shots.title: Semangat, Uwais
shots.adegan: Uwais sits on the edge of the bed with his bare feet on the floor, the grey blanket pushed aside behind him.
alur: Uwais stands up slowly beside the bed.
He stretches both arms up high over his head.
He lowers his arms and clenches both hands into small fists at chest height, standing upright.
shots.kamera: medium-wide shot at eye level, static
shots.akhir: Uwais stands beside the bed, upright, both fists at chest height.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

foley.suara: bare feet stepping softly on a wooden floor

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

dialog.text: [lazy] Hmmmm... bangun, bangun. [determined] Oke, oke... semangaaat, Uwais!

shots.title: Doa bangun tidur
shots.adegan: Uwais sits upright on the edge of the bed with his bare feet on the floor, his hands resting on his knees.
alur: Uwais raises both hands in front of his chest, palms open and facing up, in prayer.
He holds his open palms still in prayer.
He slowly lowers both hands and rests them on his knees.
shots.kamera: medium shot at eye level, slow push-in
shots.akhir: Uwais sits calmly on the edge of the bed, hands on his knees.
shots.latar: A quiet bedroom at dawn: a wall clock ticking, birds beginning to chirp outside, a distant call to prayer.

benda.letak: standing on the nightstand beside the bed
benda.akhir: standing on the nightstand beside the bed

dialog.text: [calm] Alhamdulillahilladzi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin nusyur.
